$comment: Files that belong to one machine or one person and must never be committed. Enforced by scripts/check-local-files.ts (CI check 'Forbid local files', tests/check-local-files.test.ts). Under /.github/ so CODEOWNERS makes a person read every change to this list. Patterns support * (within one path segment), ** (across directories; **/ matches zero or more) and ?, matched against repo-relative paths with forward slashes. Any other glob syntax is rejected when the policy loads. The allowlist is checked first.

forbidden.reason: Per-machine agent settings (Claude Code, Gemini CLI and others).
By convention a .local. file is per-machine, whatever its extension.
Secrets for one machine (.env, .env.production, .envrc, .envbackup, ...); only the .env.example template may be tracked.
Terraform state holds secrets and is per-environment.
